notes.title: Official discord and reddit (Also a small message about the next update)
notes.content:
Hello, how are u guys doing? Also, thanks everyone so much for the support! So, I've created a while ago a official discord for the game if u guys wanna talk a bit, also suggestions and bug fixing help can be discussed there :) [url=https://discord.gg/wugyZeSuTS]Click here to join the discord [/url]
Also, i've created a reddit so we can discuss a bit about the game, if you have any cool thing to show about the game or any suggestions, would be cool to talk a bit about it there. [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/BRAZILIANDRUGDEALER3/]Reddit link here[/url]

Also, which streamers and youtubers do you guys think would be cool covering the game? Been doing some research to make more people know about the game, being a indie dev is kinda hard so I've been researching how things work, would love to have some input and help of you guys :) 

Also, a new update is coming next month with a new map and a boss! Also, I gotta make it clear that every month, new content comes for the game so you guys always have new stuff to check out! Thank you so much for playing my game, it means the world for me, this is my homage to my country bootleg games I grew up with, I love working on this project, and upmost, I love making people smile, I hope this project makes your day better in some way

Thank you so much for this, it's one of the best times of my life. God bless you all.

notes.title: 20% OFF N' UPDATE! 2 NEW GUNS, NEW MAP AND NEW BOSS! OST AND BDD1 N 2 ON STEAM!
notes.content:
YOU CRASH YOUR AIRPLANE COMING FROM AMAZON AND YOU GET BACK TO SÃO GONÇALO'S ZE GAROTO'S PARK! There's 2 new guns, the paper airplane gun made of money that throws rays and kills a bunch of enemies around, great for crowds! And a new standard melee gun, the sandal! Also, there's now a new recurrent enemy, the flapolin, he throws pistol and mac 47 ammo once they die, so there's more of this kind of ammo scattered around now! Also, there's a new boss on the ze garoto map, the vasq cthullu, one of vasq demon goons! Take him out and help your friend flapolin escape! 

Also, the soundtrack is out now on steam alongside brazilian drug dealer 1 and 2 in the local files! you can buy it as a bundle with the game! 

God bless you all and thanks for the astonishing support! Have fun!

notes.title: 20% OFF N' UPDATE! NEW MAP, 2 NEW WEAPONS, KICK FOOTBALLS n' OST ON SPOTIFY NOW!
notes.content:
20% OFF ! BUY NOW TO SEE THE BIGGEST UPDATE YET! 

THE SUPERMARKET PORTAL MISTAKENLY SENT YOU TO MANAUS, NOW YOU NEED TO FIND A PLANE TO CONTINUE YOUR JOURNEY! EXPLORE A JUNGLE FULL OF SLOPES WITH 2 NEW WEAPONS, KICKABLE BALLS N MORE ! The 2 new weapons, one based on the berimbau (a instrument used a lot here in brazil, used to make the song from the carreta map btw) great for exploding large groups of enemies with it's spreading multi coconut bombs, and the orelhão/payphone of tchau, a automatic launcher of weird low poly green exploding coconuts, great to kill difficult enemies like the giant capibara, the loro josias and the giant red fla demon. Also, you can now kick the footballs that appear when you explode a enemy, and even play football with it! Also there's a bunch of quality of life updates in the game! 

And the OST is also out now on spotify! https://open.spotify.com/intl-pt/track/1Lq7tGWPrVc9VCA5qUa9gG?si=e1e4f6f56ec3481c I poured my heart into making this OST, thanks everyone that liked the songs, god bless and have fun with the biggest update yet for the game!

notes.title: Made some changes to metrorio, amanha n' ultimafase, also some multiplayer fixes
notes.content:
Fixed some stuff related to enemy count in metrorio, and changed some stuff on amanha related to some secrets that are now accessible. 

Woods, from the great QSS-M project, has been helping out a lot! He fixed the ultimafase crash and glitch from the last boss, now working properly, he also helped with a lot of multiplayer fixes, such as better public quake server listing, player names now appear above heads from what i've tested (it's W.I.P), and also been helping fix the issues with "server to client keepalive" issues while connecting to servers (still searching and ironing out). 

Thanks for the astonishing help, Woods! The plan for transitioning to Ironwail is being disconsidered because of the amazing help of Woods that's bringing so many cool features and helping the project so much, and also bringing these new features to Quakespasm Spiked M users in general (Check the github project out, Woods is doing magic there! [url=https://github.com/timbergeron/QSS-M]Check the github here[/url] ), Every user from low end computers can have these amazing features! The project won't have minimal specs changes at the moment because of that :D God bless Woods and a huge shoutout for his amazing work for the Quake community!

VALEU POR VOCÊ EXISTIR, AMIGO!!
